title: Phenol-Explorer: an online comprehensive database on polyphenol contents in foods
authors: Neveu V, Perez-Jiménez J, Vos F, Crespy V, du Chaffaut L, Mennen L, et al.
funder: French Ministry of Research (grant NUTRIALIS, 2002-04) and by Unilever, Danone and Nestlé (2005-09). Open access charges paid by the Institut National de la Recherche Agronomique.
authorConflicts: None declared. Three authors were affiliated with In Siliflo Inc, Edmonton.
result: Coffee beverage [Filter] (food 552), Phenol-Explorer version 3.6, read 2026-10-21; chromatography, mean content per 100 ml (minimum to maximum; n): 5-caffeoylquinic acid 70.03 mg (47.89 to 96.00; 4); 4-caffeoylquinic acid 59.60 mg (53.00 to 66.21; 2); 3-caffeoylquinic acid 51.80 mg (40.00 to 63.60; 2); 5-feruloylquinic acid 11.69 mg (1); 4-feruloylquinic acid 8.57 mg (1); 3-feruloylquinic acid 4.17 mg (1); 3,4-, 4,5- and 3,5-dicaffeoylquinic acids 2.66, 2.05 and 1.55 mg (1 each); caffeic acid 0.03 mg. Total polyphenols by Folin assay 266.70 mg (245.54 to 281.82; 3). Compound 475, 5-caffeoylquinic acid: synonym chlorogenic acid; phenolic acid, hydroxycinnamic acid subclass; C16H18O9.
